description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 03/2023, Business Hours for Liquor Licensed Extablishments
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new regulatory business hours for liquor licensed establishments under the Excise Ordinance. It is a legal/regulatory instrument that modifies existing regulations (rescinding previous notifications) and sets compliance requirements for commercial establishments, falling squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than a personnel appointment or portfolio description.
